summary_en: FY2/27 dividend per share raised ¥1.00 to ¥51.00 (from ¥50.00). Period end only (no interim). Full-year earnings forecast revised upward: operating profit ¥5,450M (+3.8%), net income ¥3,450M (+3.0%). Increase driven by strong creative (Japan) and medical divisions, plus Takahashi Shoten Group acquisition contribution. Target payout ratio 30%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: CREEK & RIVER Co. announced on 9 July 2026 a revision to its earnings and dividend forecasts for fiscal year ending 28 February 2027. The company raised FY2/27 full-year operating profit to ¥5,450M (from ¥5,250M, +3.8%) and net income to ¥3,450M (from ¥3,350M, +3.0%) based on strong first-quarter results. The annual dividend per share was increased by ¥1.00 to ¥51.00 (from ¥50.00), payable at fiscal year-end only (no interim dividend). The revision reflects robust performance in the core creative (Japan) and medical divisions, as well as the positive contribution from the Takahashi Shoten Group (consolidated as a subsidiary in March 2025). The company's stated dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%, balancing shareholder returns with internal retained earnings for business strengthening.
